notes: The Axis product page loads its details with scripts and could not be read, so this pack comes from Axis's Horizon terms and conditions PDF, which appears to date from mid-2024. Lounge access in particular may since have gained a spend condition; those rules are marked unverified. The PDF gives no annual-fee waiver condition, no forex mark-up and no rupee value for EDGE Miles (they transfer 1:1 to partner programmes).

sources.title: Axis Bank – Terms and conditions for HORIZON Credit Card (PDF)
Axis Bank – HORIZON Credit Card (page could not be read)

items.label: 1% fuel surcharge waived on ₹400–₹5,000 transactions, up to ₹400 a statement month
items.clause: with a max cap of INR 400 on wavier in the statement month

earnRules.label: 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on other spends
earnRules.clause: 2 EDGE Miles for every INR 100 spent on other spends

earnRules.label: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on Axis Bank Travel EDGE
earnRules.clause: 5 EDGE Miles for every INR 100 spent

earnRules.label: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 booking directly with airlines (travel agents and OTAs earn only 2)
earnRules.clause: Bookings via travel agents ... shall be eligible for only 2 EDGE Miles for every INR 100 spent

exclusions.label: No EDGE Miles on fuel, rent, wallet loads, utilities, insurance, education, government, transport and tolls
exclusions.clause: Transportation & tolls, utilities, insurance, educational institutions, government institutions, wallets, rent, and fuel

lounge.label: 2 international lounge visits a calendar quarter
lounge.clause: 2 complimentary lounge access per calendar quarter

lounge.label: 8 domestic lounge visits a calendar quarter on Visa Signature (6 on Mastercard World)

otherBenefits.label: Welcome: 5,000 EDGE Miles on a first transaction above ₹1,000 within 30 days of issue
otherBenefits.detail: Not for cards switched or migrated from another Axis card.
otherBenefits.clause: 5,000 EDGE Miles on the first transaction over INR 1,000 within 30 days

otherBenefits.label: Renewal: 1,500 EDGE Miles each card anniversary from the second year (primary card)
otherBenefits.clause: 1,500 miles each anniversary, starting from the second anniversary year

otherBenefits.label: EDGE Miles transfer 1:1 to airline and hotel partner programmes (minimum 500)
otherBenefits.detail: Also redeemable on Travel EDGE bookings and the rewards catalogue.

otherBenefits.label: Lost card liability cover up to ₹10 lakh
otherBenefits.detail: Covers fraud up to 2 days before you block the card; needs a police complaint and claim within 30 days.
otherBenefits.clause: up to a limit of INR 10 lacs
